title: Would be honored to have anyone interested join my playtest on Sunday for my in-browser MOBA! It's been nearly 1 year of nose to the grindstone development and I'm so excited about the progress.
author: ADIRTYHOBO59
selftext:
Mercenaries of Tezigdal is an in-browser MOBA inspired by League of Legends that features some key twists. With Implements you can purchase upgrades to your base to fortify structures or increase your utility. Faculties allow you to toggle off and on base functionality to increase passive gold. Golem Craft allows you to gather crafting materials in the jungle to create more powerful waves to flood the enemy base.


Would love to host a playtest this Sunday at 1:00pm EST. A full 5v5 match would be amazing. The playtest will be US only as I only have one server for the game at the moment and it is located in New York.

[https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/](https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/ADIRTYHOBO59, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: Thank you very much for letting me know. I've added more detail. I can add more if needed
